ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface comprising approximately 85-90% of the visible area, contrasted with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated along the trailing edge and in discrete focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central field is a contiguous high-intensity white mass. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms an irregular, thick boundary along the trailing edge and tips. Distinct, dark circular and annular blobs are non-uniformly distributed across both the left and right lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio within the bounding notch area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with varying pixel amplitudes; the topography is notably jagged and irregular across both lobes, distinct from the smooth water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the upper margin of the lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips which exhibit an upward vertical sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (dark pigmentation enclosing or adjacent to white pixels) distributed across the ventral surface, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (light-colored scratches) crossing through the dark pigmentation on the distal regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the fluke surface; irregular micro-notches and jagged wear along the trailing edge suggesting mechanical trauma or natural erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'hollow ring' pigmentation markers characterized by dark perimeters around white centers, creating a 'donut' visual effect across the mid-section of the fluke.
